summary.description: What was changed, in one line first: that line becomes the commit subject.

filesChanged.description: Every workspace file this session created, edited or deleted, as a path relative to the workspace root.

testsRun.description: Each build or test command that was run and what it reported.

risks.description: What a reviewer should look at hardest, or "none".

deviationFromNote.description: Empty when the change is exactly the note's Proposed Fix. Otherwise say plainly what was done differently and why; a non-empty value stops the push until a human accepts it.
